$comment: Approved Higgsfield micro-clips consumed by scripts/compose-transformation.py. A clip is used for its stage's motion ONLY when it is listed here AND approved is true, so a billed-but-rejected generation never silently reaches the master video. Exposure, hand compositing and every cut point stay compositor-controlled regardless. Generate a clip with POST /api/transformation/clip, download the completed result into public/transformation/clips/, then add its entry here.

schema.stageId: a transformation stage id that introduces objects (see GET /api/transformation/clip for the plan)
schema.file: site-relative path to the downloaded clip, e.g. /transformation/clips/island.mp4
schema.approved: boolean — only true clips are composited
schema.jobId: optional: the generation job id this came from, for traceability
schema.prompt: optional: the exact prompt used, for reproducibility
